text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Faysal Islamic Bank and the Islamic Investment Company of the Gulf arrange $100 million financing facility for Pakistan's Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Resources.
- Some 1.896 million shares were traded on the Bahrain stock market on Wednesday.
- Bahrain's oil and industry minister says Bahrain's Alba aluminium company's annual production will rise to half a million tonnes by mid-1997.
